_readme: Settings of the sewer DPR workbook (sewer_app/dpr.py), in the format of the Riverside Zone Sewerage Scheme estimate (UPJN, Springfield City Council; hydraulic_design_data_sheet_sample\Copy of Riverside SewerEstimate.xlsx). RATES: the finalised rates of data/sewer_sor_rates.json (excavation, timbering, laying, granular bedding, road reinstatement, dewatering) and the pipe rate of data/sewer_catalog.json are used as they are - they are NOT repeated here. Here only the quantity rules of that DPR and the rates sewer_sor_rates.json does not have (manhole unit estimates, road cutting, interlocking reinstatement, barricading, disposal, lump items - Riverside DPR values): yellow in the workbook, column 'Rate from' says so - to be confirmed. Every value keeps its source.

office.value: OFFICE OF THE EXECUTIVE ENGINEER, U.P. JAL NIGAM (URBAN)
office._source: Riverside DPR, sheet 'Form j civil' A1 (division name left out)

water_supply_lpcd._source: Riverside DPR, sheet 'HY DESIGN STATEMENT_1' row 3 (sewage = 80 % of water supply, CPHEEO 3.4.1 p3-3)

trench._source: Riverside DPR, sheet 'Qty' H6:S6 - same rule as data/sewer_sor_rates.json trench_width_m
trench.note: n = ROUNDUP(depth / 1.5); top slice width = D + 0.6 + 0.5 x (n - 1), each lower slice 0.5 m narrower, bottom slice D + 0.6. The DPR stops at 6 slices (9 m); here 8 (12 m, SOR 3001-3006.ii).

timbering._source: Riverside DPR, sheet 'Qty' AL6 (open 0-3 m), AO6 / AP6 (close 3-6 / 6-9 m), sheet 'BOQ' E17:E19 (2 % close timbering left in the trench); min_depth_m: PROJECT DECISION (user, 11-Oct-2026, data/sewer_sor_rates.json timbering_rule) - no timbering for a trench not deeper than 1.5 m

bedding._source: Riverside DPR, sheet 'Qty' AX6 (width D + 0.35 m below 800 mm, else 1.25 D) and AY6 (thickness 0.45 D + 100 mm)
bedding.note: Priced as granular bedding, data/sewer_sor_rates.json granular_bedding (SOR 106.1-106.8 by depth); bedding_rule there is still a PROJECT DECISION PENDING. The Riverside BOQ prices the same volume both as cement concrete (1015.A) and as granular (AOR 2274); here once.

manholes._source: Riverside DPR, sheet 'BOQ' items 11-12 (rows 201-211, 'Unit Estimate Attached') and sheet 'Qty' BY6:CF6 (depth classes 0.90-1.65 / 1.65-2.30 / 2.30-4.95 / 4.95-9.0 m)
manholes.note: Circular brick masonry manhole by depth; extra for every 1 m deeper (or less, negative) than the unit depth. The DPR counts ROUND(length / 50) manholes per sewer at the sewer's average depth; here every manhole of the design at its own depth (GL - invert). A manhole shallower than 0.90 m falls in the first class (the DPR leaves it out).

road._source: Riverside DPR, sheet 'BOQ' items 13-14 (rows 213-222: dismantling 'Rate Analysis', interlocking reinstatement); road type per sewer as sheet 'Qty' X6:AF6 (1 Bitumen, 2 CC, 3 Interlocking)
road.note: USER DECISION (22-Oct-2026): every sewer CC by default; the type can be changed per sewer in sheet Qty (1 / 2 / 3). Area = top trench width x length. Bitumen and CC reinstatement: data/sewer_sor_rates.json road_reinstatement (PWD-5 / PWD-4); cutting rates and interlocking reinstatement are not there (Riverside values, to be confirmed).

barricading._source: Riverside DPR, sheet 'BOQ' item 16 (row 257, Rate Analysis)

disposal._source: Riverside DPR, sheet 'BOQ' item 17 (row 258, AOR): volume of the pipes and manholes

value.name: Diversion of existing sewer line during laying of new sewer
Sand filling in trench for cushion of pipe
Shifting and reinstatement of electric and telephone poles

lump_items.note: Quantities per project (survey) - 0 until the user fills them in sheet BOQ. Dewatering: data/sewer_sor_rates.json dewatering (SOR 3031), quantity 0 likewise.

forecast._source: Riverside DPR, sheet 'T' rows 44-161 (census 1951-2011 + 2025, arithmetical / incremental / geometrical increase; geometrical adopted: 'Tech ' J108 = 'T' L153) and sheet 'Tech ' rows 131-137 (floating and institutional population 10 %, equivalent at 45 / 150 lpcd; return factor 0.8)
forecast.note: USER DECISION (22-Oct-2026): the base-year population and the census figures are given on the page; the +15 / +30 years population and the floating population are computed (population.py) and the design runs on them. default_decadal_rate = Riverside's geometrical rate for Springfield City Council (28.74 % per decade, 'T' U55) - used only without census figures. Water supply for the floating equivalent = sewage lpcd / return factor.

population._source: Riverside DPR, sheet 'Tech ' X108 = base-year population / households of the city (2,818,720 / 463,856 = 6.08)
population.note: Households = population / persons per household; house connections = base-year households (Riverside 'Tech ' L126 -> hcc2 D3). The base-year population is the page's 'आधार वर्ष आबादी' (pop_initial); without it the design population is used and the cell says so.

house_connection._source: Riverside DPR, sheets 'hcc2' (road shares), 'hcc3' (areas per connection / H.C.C., items 2-5 and their unit rates), 'house connection' (reinstatement), 'Table 160' (cost); B.O.E rates: sheet 'BOQ' F216 / F223
house_connection.note: Unit rates of the H.C.C., the 110 mm domestic connection, the 160 mm line to the manhole and the interceptor chamber are Riverside unit estimates - not in sewer_sor_rates.json (yellow, to be confirmed).

om._source: Riverside DPR, sheets 'Sewer Lines and RM' (0.25 % / 1.5 % repairs, 6 % inflation), '5 yr O&M' (SPS: machinery 3 % a year with 6 % inflation from the 3rd year - 2 years defect liability; electricity and diesel flat; operation cost Rs 18.24 lakh a year + 3 %), 'ABS (O&M)' (GST 18 %, centage 10 %), 'STP (O&M)' (power: fixed Rs 350 / kW / month, Rs 8.3 / kWh, duty 7.5 %, surcharge 4.28 %; DG: 0.2 l / kVA / hour, 2 hours a day, Rs 90 / l, lubricant 5 %, servicing Rs 1.5 lakh)

staff: Fitter multi purpose work / Tax collector

economics._source: Riverside DPR, sheets 'ECONOMICS' / ' INCOME 1' (tariff Rs 175 / 350 / 450 per household per month), 'A.R. EXP ON M. STAFF 1', ' REPAIR WORKS 1' (repair % by sub head), 'RECURRING EXP1'

utility_shifting_share._source: Riverside DPR, sheet 'BOQ' item 22 (row 264): provision for shifting of cables / gas pipes, 0.25 % of the sub total

form_j._source: Riverside DPR, sheet 'Form j civil' rows 9-22 (amounts in Rs lakh; centage slabs up to 25 / 50 / 100 Cr and above)
